subject: [hw] opus-ios: HIGH link defect: vcodecd linked against libn2vhost.a silently loses the thread+stdio shim tables (77 unresolved imports)
body: [V] host, today. host/n2vhost.c:48-51 DEFINES weak stand-ins n2shim_thread/n2shim_stdio/n2shim_android/n2shim_data_all. A static-archive link takes the weak definition from n2vhost.o and never pulls shim/n2shim_thread.o / n2shim_stdio.o out of libn2vhost.a (an archive member is only extracted for an UNDEFINED symbol). Result with a plain `cc x.c libn2vhost.a`: N2VHOST tables thread=0(V32) stdio=0(V33), "M-a ... 77 unresolved imports" (pthread_*, fopen, ioctl, open, ...), vpud never reaches M-c. Same link with --whole-archive: tables thread=66 stdio=27, 0 unresolved, M-c reached. IVs own runner is unaffected (it links the objects directly). Affected: build_ios.sh vcodecd link (`... "$VHOST_LIB" ...` at build_ios.sh:171) and daemon/test/run_tests.sh IP-REAL link -- the phone vcodecd would come up without threads/stdio. Fix (pick one): (a) IP: link with -Wl,-force_load,"$VHOST_LIB" for ld64.lld and -Wl,--whole-archive ... -Wl,--no-whole-archive on Linux; (b) IV: drop the weak DEFINITIONS (declare extern weak and test the address, as already done for n2shim_set at :56) so the archive members are pulled. (a) is a one-line change and is what my n2vcd_selftest build uses. Please also add a check to the IP-REAL test: the N2VHOST tables line must not contain "=0(".
